statements.t: As a result, we do not believe that the Russian invasion of Ukraine or the conflict in Israel and Gaza will have a direct impact on our results.
Thus far, we have been able to pass along these increases to our customers, but there is no guarantee that we will be able to continue this in the future.
The additional inventory is intended to maintain continuity of customer supply during the Company’s planned facility relocation and associated production transition.
The Company expects it will continue to be able to fund its operations for the remainder of 2026 from operations and existing cash balances.

In addition, the Company anticipates approximately $10 million in capital expenditures during 2027 related to the build-out of its Attleboro facility, a portion of which is expected to be reimbursable through the $3.2 million tenant improvement allowance provided under the lease.
The Company expects to fund these expenditures through existing cash balances, proceeds from the liquidation or maturity of marketable securities, and cash generated from operations.

However, there is no assurance that we will be able to generate sufficient revenues or reduce certain discretionary spending in the event that planned operational goals are not met such that we will be able to meet our obligations as they become due.

The Company expects to incur approximately $10 million in costs during 2027 to prepare the new facility for occupancy, of which up to $3.2 million may be reimbursed by the landlord under the terms of the lease.
The Company anticipates relocating its operations toward the end of 2027, with base rent payments under the new lease beginning in December 2027.
The Company will be hosting its third quarter 2026 earnings call tomorrow, November 4, 2026, at 9:00 a.m.
